name: pdfcpu
description: pdfcpu — PDF processing CLI. Encrypt, decrypt, optimize, merge, split, stamp, and extract PDFs. Go-based.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/pdfcpu/pdfcpu/releases/download/v0.12.0/pdfcpu_0.12.0_Linux_x86_64.tar.xz && tar xf pdfcpu_0.12.0_Linux_x86_64.tar.xz && sudo mv pdfcpu /usr/local/bin/ && rm pdfcpu_0.12.0_Linux_x86_64.tar.xz

commands.description: pdfcpu — PDF processing CLI. Encrypt, decrypt, optimize, merge, split, stamp, and extract PDFs. Go-based.
